title: Project Overview
description: MapleSpike is Canada's sovereign, AI-native government data pipeline — one unified layer for government data, corporate influence tracking, committee surveillance, regulatory intelligence, and policy actor tracking.

title: Pipeline Core — Data Ingestion
description: The heart of MapleSpike: the ingestion pipeline with 142+ ingestion modules, registry, fetchers, parsers, quality scoring, and entity resolution across all Canadian data sources.

title: MCP Server — AI Agent Interface
description: The Model Context Protocol server that exposes 53+ MCP tools for AI agents to query Canadian government data via natural language.

title: API Server — REST Interface
description: REST API with authentication, caching, rate limiting, and structured data endpoints for programmatic access.

title: Engine — Query & Entity Resolution
description: Query engine that allows cross-module entity linking — resolve a person across committees, lobbying records, corporate filings, and regulatory data.

title: Web Portal
description: Static HTML/CSS/JS web portal with bilingual (EN/FR) support, responsive design, and data browsing interface.

title: CI/CD and Infrastructure
description: GitHub Actions CI pipeline, Docker containerization, NixOS/K3s deployment infrastructure.
